verdict.rationale: OpenTofu documents separating planning from execution: `tofu plan -out=FILE` saves a plan that `tofu apply` later executes exactly. Speculative plans can also be reviewed before code review. Together these give an agent workflow a reviewable plan-then-apply step. The pack shows no least-privilege credential scoping, no policy-as-code enforcement, and no built-in gate that blocks an agent from applying unapproved changes. missing for 10: least-privilege/scoped credential support, enforced approval gates or policy checks that block unapproved applies, agent-specific guardrails, independent corroboration of review-gated agent workflows
